name: Deborah "Debby" Pope
office: Chicago Board of Education Member, Subdistrict 2B

items.text: Mayor Brandon Johnson appointed Pope to the Chicago Board of Education in 2024 after previous members resigned. She is a retired Chicago Public Schools bilingual history and English as a Second Language teacher. She later worked for the Chicago Teachers Union as a class size coordinator and grievance correspondent. Pope co-chairs the board’s Special Education Advisory Committee.

sentences.text: Mayor Brandon Johnson appointed Pope to the Chicago Board of Education in 2024 after previous members resigned.
She is a retired Chicago Public Schools bilingual history and English as a Second Language teacher.
She later worked for the Chicago Teachers Union as a class size coordinator and grievance correspondent.
Pope co-chairs the board’s Special Education Advisory Committee.

items.text: Pope supports increased state funding and greater tax contributions from wealthy residents. She advocates expanding early childhood programs to help low-income families and students with disabilities. She signed a pledge supporting a three-year ban on artificial intelligence in schools. Pope has supported preserving schools and increasing community input on closures. She supports sustainability efforts like solar power and electric school buses.
